name: Trichotillomania
advice: This is a habit-pulling disorder — habit reversal training/CBT with a psychologist is the main treatment. Keep hands busy (stress ball), wear gloves or a cap at night, keep hair short. Report tummy pain/vomiting if hair is swallowed. Screen for anxiety, depression and OCD.
